posts.author: Anuj2
posts.text: Arihant Capital Investor call notes: Drop in Q1 FY27 top line due to change in procurement policy of parent company, they want the inventory just in time i.e. 7 days. SIS retail increased from 16 Crores in Q1 FY26 to 27 Crores in Q1 FY27 PAT margins expected to be 17%-18% due to EBO expansion Takeaway: FY27 PAT estimate = 1.25*149*0.18 = 33.525 Crores (FY26 PAT: 31 Crores) Revenue growth guidance reduced to 25% Disclosure: Invested & considering to exit the position
